content.problemStatement: Write a program for the coding challenge "Compatible Numbers". Refer to SEED-IT description: https://codeforces.com/contest/165/problem/E
content.inputFormat: The first line contains an integer n. The second line contains n integers.
content.outputFormat: The output should be the maximum number of compatible pairs.

hidden.label: tricky case / empty-like / negative if allowed

solution.approach: Create a graph where each number is a node and two nodes are connected if the numbers are compatible. Then find the maximum matching in the graph.
